records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Collective
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Good to talk last week. Since then I haven't seen a first project on the account yet, so I wanted to check in before things get busy again.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating one is the clearest way to see how your team's work will sit here. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
